keep.title: Keep it. Watch it add up.
keep.body: Go live your day. An evening reminder brings you back, and every promise lands in your ledger as a credit or a debit.

pains.heading: Switch on what sounds like you.
pains.support: Most plans fail for the same few reasons. Kept is built around each one.
pains.count: {count, plural, one {# of these sounds like you.} other {# of these sound like you.}} That’s what Kept is for.

stop.q: I start strong, then stop after a week.
stop.a: Kept starts you small, so day one is easy. It only asks for more after three Yeses in a row.

today.q: I never know what to actually do today.
today.a: Every evening you leave with one sentence: when, and exactly what. No list to decide from.

forget.q: I read the advice, then forget it.
forget.a: You explain one idea back in your own words. Ideas you forget come back sooner.

badDay.q: One bad day and I give up.
badDay.a: Two Noes shrink the promise instead of ending it. A missed day never counts against you.

plan.heading: Type a goal. Get a plan that starts small.
plan.support: Every plan has 2 to 4 milestones, 3 to 5 daily actions that each come in three sizes, and the key ideas that explain why they work. You can change it before you start.
plan.goalLabel: What do you want to get better at?
plan.goal: I want to run 5k without stopping.

shoes.small: Put your shoes by the door

ledger.heading: Kept, like the books.
ledger.body: Your progress is a ledger. Promises kept are credits, slips are debits, and a Partly counts as half. Kept shrinks your next promise after misses and grows it after good runs.

dayOne.a: About five minutes of setup: your goal, how long you’ll give it, where you are now and what gets in your way. Kept turns that into a plan and your first promise.

ai.a: It suggests your plan, marks your answers when you explain an idea back, and helps you choose a promise when you’re stuck.

missed.q: What if I miss a day?
missed.a: It doesn’t count against you. A promise you don’t report by the end of the next day closes as unreported, and your promises don’t shrink because of it.

install.q: Do I need to install anything?
install.a: No. Kept runs in your browser. One calendar reminder, added once, brings you back each evening and opens today’s screen.

numbers.a: Only you see your plan. Our public results page shows totals across everyone testing Kept, with no names, emails or goals.

advice.q: Is this medical or financial advice?
advice.a: No. Kept helps you build habits toward your own goal. It is not medical, financial or professional advice.

cta.heading: Make your first promise tonight.
cta.note: Next you pick a password. Then about five minutes of setup, and your first promise.

footer.legal: Kept helps people build habits toward their own goals. It is not medical, financial or professional advice.
